title: Punctuation and quotation marks
summary: See how languages and writing systems mark quoted speech in different ways.

reveal.title: Quotes can look different
reveal.body: Languages do not all mark quoted speech the same way.

compare.title: Same job, different marks
compare.body: Compare the quotation conventions used by languages you already have open.

focus.title: How this language marks quotes
focus.body: Look at the delimiters, spacing, punctuation placement, and speaker conventions used here.

practice.title: Spot the quotation
practice.prompt: Choose the text that follows this language’s quotation conventions.

story.title: Find it in the story
story.body: Return to the quotation that introduced this topic and notice what the punctuation is doing.

complete.title: You can read the signals
complete.body: Quotation marks are part of a writing system, not universal decoration.
